messages:
maya: Morning all — I'm taking the 12h oncall window starting now. Quick handoff notes:

maya: 1) REM-213 (kv cache replay edge-case) — fix merged in staging (PR #482). Need a quick smoke: prefix cache/eviction path. Steps below.

maya: 2) Planned low-risk rolling restart of canary pool at 14:00 UTC to pick up kernel patches. @devon you free to own the restart and rollback if we see CPU spike?

maya: 3) Embedder 429s: I lowered alert threshold to 2% for the next 6h. Watch latency dashboard and reply here if you see >1.5% sustained.

maya: Smoke test steps (staging):
```bash
# run a small burst to warm prefix and check kv hits
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 'https://staging.redwood/api/generate' -d '{"prompt":"warm cache test","max_tokens":10}'; done
```

maya: Expect logs with `kv_cache:hit` and no `kv_cache:replay` entries. If you see `kv_cache:replay` > 0 please escalate and tag me.

devon: I can take the restart. I'll be on standby from 13:45 UTC. I can rollback to previous image if CPU > 70% on canary for 5m. :thumbsup: 

alex: Quick follow on REM-213 — I ran the smoke on staging, got 2 `kv_cache:replay` lines out of ~200 calls. Digging into trace now, looks like a race in the warm path when sequence length spikes.

sam: I can help validate. Which test harness did you use? I can run the same in staging-2.

maya: alex — please paste the trace snippet. sam — use the same curl loop, but add header `X-Seq-Len: 1024` to simulate long context.

alex: trace snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] kv_cache:miss key=abc123 seq_len=1024 shard=3
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] kv_cache:replay key=abc123 seq_len=1024 shard=3
```

alex: Looks like eviction and replay race when seq_len large. I left notes on the PR with a repro and toggles.

maya: Action items: 1) alex to add a guard in PR to avoid replay on eviction window (in flight patch). 2) devon to run rolling restart at 14:00 and monitor CPU and 429s. 3) sam + alex to re-run smoke with seq header and post observations by 16:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled restart (canary) set for 2026-03-15T14:00:00Z. Channel: #eng-oncall. Escalation window set to 30m.

sam: Running smoke now on staging-2. Will paste quick results in 10m.

devon: Also FYI — I'll disable autoscaler for canary during restart to prevent unexpected scale events.

maya: Good call. Add that to runbook — thank you.

sam: Results: 200 calls, 0 `kv_cache:replay`, 192 `kv_cache:hit`. Latency stable. :white_check_mark:

alex: Re-ran with different seed, still seeing sporadic `kv_cache:replay` (~1/300). I filed REM-213-1 to track the repro in CI. Suggest we don't reopen the original postmortem until we confirm stable in prod for 24h.

maya: Agreed. If we see >0.5% replays in prod for an hour, reopen REM-213 and assign to SRE+ML infra.

devon: Restart done at 14:05 UTC. No CPU spike; embedder 429s unchanged. Rolling canary healthy. :thumbsup: 

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll do the afternoon handoff at 20:00 UTC unless someone swaps. If anyone needs coverage swap, ping here.

alex: FYI I left a code comment on PR asking for an extra unit test around eviction. tagging @sam for review later.

sam: Will review PR in the next 2 hours.

maya: Closing handoff thread — keeps all follow-ups here. :rocket:
